MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.

   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Production Systems.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Morphology and Anatomy? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Morphology and Anatomy.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.

15. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Pond? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Pond.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Pond.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Pond.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Pond.
